newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin soars 25 cents on ringgit, LME factors.
newsitem.headline: KL tin soars 25 cents on ringgit, LME factors.

text.p: Malaysia's spot tin price jumped 25 cents to close at 13.77 ringgit ($5.43) a kg on Monday, after players were inspired to bid strongly for the metal due to a weaker ringgit, traders said.
They said higher values on the London Metal Exchange (LME) on Friday also prompted buyers to lift the tin price from a 27-month low at last week's close.
The closing price on Monday was at par with London, compared to the premium of $40 a tonne on Friday.
"There was a lot of short-covering as the ringgit had weakened considerably against the dollar and made tin cheaper," said a trader.
He said the firm finish of tin also meant a new resistance level of 13.80 ringgit and support at 13.50 for the metal.
In Monday's trading, initial bids overwhelmed offers by 230 tonnes to 63. Final turnover was 120 tonnes, against 103 on Friday, and was absorbed by Europeans, Japanese and locals.
